# QBCC Home Warranty Insurance Calculator

> This free QBCC home warranty insurance calculator gives Queensland builders and homeowners the premium and QLeave levy for residential building work.

Pick new construction or renovation, enter the insurable value including GST, and set the number of dwellings. Your estimate updates as you type. It uses the QBCC premium tables effective 1 July 2020. It is an estimate only, so confirm the final figure with QBCC.

Choose the work type: new construction, or renovation and addition. Enter the insurable value, including GST, labour and materials. Add the number of dwellings and the total value is split equally. If the cost of work for QLeave is different, you can enter that separately.

You get the QBCC premium, the QLeave levy and the estimated total. Each estimate has its own page showing the rates used and the sources. You can edit it, start a new one, or have it emailed to you.

The premium and the QLeave levy are separate costs. List them separately in your quote. The levy is 0.575% of the GST-exclusive value. This site is independent and not affiliated with QBCC, so verify final amounts with QBCC and QLeave before payment. Operated by Leva Solutions.

On the calculator page, WebMCP can update the visible estimate. It does not email, lodge, purchase insurance, or save contact information.

- [Premium tables](https://www.qbccinsurancecalculator.com.au/premium-table): Separate tables for new homes and for renovations, alterations, additions and repairs.
- [Cost guide](https://www.qbccinsurancecalculator.com.au/costs): List the premium and the QLeave levy separately.
- [FAQ](https://www.qbccinsurancecalculator.com.au/faq): When cover is required, who pays, and how accurate the calculator is.
- [Who needs cover](https://www.qbccinsurancecalculator.com.au/who-needs-it): The licensed contractor takes out the policy with QBCC.
